content.short: RabbitX is a high-performance perpetual futures DEX on Starknet offering zero-gas, CEX-like trading.
content.description:
RabbitX is a premier decentralized perpetual futures exchange built natively on the Starknet Layer 2 network, designed to provide a professional-grade trading experience with the speed and efficiency of a centralized platform. Utilizing an off-chain order book for near-instant trade matching combined with secure on-chain settlement, the platform offers users lightning-fast execution and zero gas fees. RabbitX enables participants to trade a wide variety of perpetual markets with up to 20x leverage in a completely transparent and non-custodial environment.

Designed for sophisticated traders, the protocol focuses on institutional-grade risk management and deep liquidity without the risks associated with centralized intermediaries. RabbitX prioritizes user sovereignty and privacy, ensuring that all trades are settled with the robust security of the Ethereum mainnet. Through its commitment to technological innovation and high-frequency performance, RabbitX is building the essential infrastructure for the next generation of decentralized derivatives, empowering participants to trade global markets with unparalleled precision and security.
